description: This file defines the SparkConnectExecutionManager class, which manages execution sessions, handles creation, removal, reattachment, and periodic cleanup of execution holders within the Spark SQL Connect service. It includes mechanisms for tracking active and abandoned executions, scheduling maintenance tasks, and interfacing with gRPC response senders.

classes.name: ExecuteKey
classes.description: A case class representing a unique key for execution sessions, identified by userId, sessionId, and operationId.

classes.name: SparkConnectExecutionManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing all active and abandoned execution sessions, including creation, removal, reattachment, and periodic cleanup.

methods.name: createExecuteHolder
methods.description: Creates and registers a new ExecuteHolder with the global manager and session, given an execution key, request, and session.

methods.name: createExecuteHolder
methods.description: Overloaded method that creates an ExecuteHolder from a request, establishing a session if needed.

methods.name: removeExecuteHolder
methods.description: Removes an ExecuteHolder from the manager, optionally marking it as abandoned, and closes associated resources.

methods.name: getExecuteHolder
methods.description: Retrieves an ExecuteHolder by its execution key.

methods.name: createExecuteHolderAndAttach
methods.description: Creates an ExecuteHolder, registers it, and attaches a gRPC response observer for streaming responses.

methods.name: reattachExecuteHolder
methods.description: Reattaches a response observer to an existing ExecuteHolder, optionally resuming from a specific response ID.

methods.name: removeAllExecutionsForSession
methods.description: Removes all executions associated with a specific session key.

methods.name: getAbandonedTombstone
methods.description: Retrieves info about an abandoned execution if it exists.

methods.name: listActiveExecutions
methods.description: Returns either the timestamp of the last active execution or a list of all active executions.

methods.name: listAbandonedExecutions
methods.description: Returns a list of all abandoned execution info objects.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the execution manager, stopping scheduled maintenance and clearing resources.

methods.name: updateLastExecutionTime
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the last execution removal.

methods.name: schedulePeriodicChecks
methods.description: Schedules periodic maintenance tasks to clean up abandoned or expired executions.

methods.name: periodicMaintenance
methods.description: Performs cleanup of executions that have been detached and expired.

methods.name: setAllRPCsDeadline
methods.description: Sets deadlines for all gRPC response senders (for testing).

methods.name: interruptAllRPCs
methods.description: Interrupts all gRPC response senders (for testing).

methods.name: listExecuteHolders
methods.description: Returns a list of all current ExecuteHolder instances.
